registered: 2026-10-17, before any candidate below was evaluated
reference: SUB = T_main (submission 5cd305c); variants.make() with defaults must reproduce it to 1e-9 Ah

candidates.P1a_fb_beta: fallback increment multiplied by the same beta_a4 the phase branch uses (visible 25 C anchors, prior 1, tau 1)
candidates.P1b_fb_beta_skip1: as P1a, and the fallback increment starts at the second program after the anchor when >= 3 programs exist
candidates.P1c_beta_direct: phase beta from past phase-matched pairs (anchor dQ vs month-end 45 C step change, v2.beta_direct) instead of the charge-side step-to-top
candidates.P1ref_prior_1_over_b: REFERENCE ONLY, not causal: beta prior 1/0.745 (round 8 full-data fit), fallback x beta; never adoptable
candidates.P2a_median: discharge step depth = median of the 4 cells instead of the mean (beta estimation unchanged)
candidates.P2b_min: discharge step depth = minimum over the 4 cells (shallowest step) instead of the mean

scenarios: real, PG1, PG2, PC5 (k3-7), PC10 (k3-7), CS, CSE, PC5_all, PC10_all; deltas 0/0.4/0.8; step main; A4 2 Ah

gates_vs_SUB_at_delta_0.4.G_pseudo: mean MAE over PG1, PG2, PC5, PC10 <= SUB + 0.005 pp
gates_vs_SUB_at_delta_0.4.G_cold: mean MAE over CS, CSE <= SUB + 0.005 pp
gates_vs_SUB_at_delta_0.4.G_changed: over the non-real cases whose prediction changes by > 1e-9 Ah: mean |err| decreases by >= 0.02 pp AND no single such case worsens by > 0.10 pp; if no non-real case changes the candidate is untestable and not adoptable
gates_vs_SUB_at_delta_0.4.G_real_safety: real proxy MAX at each delta not worse than SUB by > 0.10 pp (real numbers are exposed; reported, not used for selection otherwise)

adoption: a causal candidate passing all four gates is recommended for wiring; if several pass, the one with the lowest mean |err| on the changed non-real cases; otherwise SUB stays
